name: KnowBe4
description: KnowBe4 is a security awareness training and human risk management platform that combines AI-personalized training content, simulated phishing/vishing attacks, real-time coaching, and email security add-ons to reduce employee-driven security risk.
best_for: Security and compliance teams wanting to reduce employee-driven breach risk through phishing simulations, AI-personalized security-awareness training, and behavior-based coaching, with published per-seat list pricing.
features: Security awareness training content personalized by AI to each user's role, risk level, and behavior, with training localized in 35+ languages
AI-generated phishing and vishing simulation attacks modeled on current attack tactics
Real-time coaching delivered at the moment of risk, aimed at turning mistakes into teachable moments
PhishER Plus incident response add-on for triaging and responding to user-reported emails
Defend (inbound) and Prevent (outbound) email security products
AIDA (AI Defense Agents) behavior-based detection and Agent Risk Manager for visibility and control over AI agent workforces
pros: Publishes real per-seat list pricing broken out by organization size, which is uncommon among security-awareness vendors
Training content is AI-personalized to role, risk level, and behavior and localized in 35+ languages
cons: Published per-seat list pricing requires a 3-year contract term; organizations of 1,001+ users must contact sales for a quote
List pricing is explicitly dated ("Pricing as per May 2026") and may be modified at any time, per KnowBe4's own pricing page

tiers.name: SAT Foundation (25-50 users)
tiers.notes: Entry-level training content tier. Requires a 3-year term; monthly-equivalent list price. Higher user-count bands (51-100, 101-250, 251-500, 501-1,000) step down in price per seat.

tiers.name: SAT Advanced (25-50 users)
tiers.notes: Adds advanced training content library on top of Foundation. Requires a 3-year term.

tiers.name: 1,001+ users
tiers.notes: Contact KnowBe4 for a custom quote; no list price published above the 501-1,000 user band.

alternatives.name: Duo Security
alternatives.description: Duo Security, part of Cisco, is an identity and access management platform providing multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and device trust for securing logins.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams wanting to reduce human-driven breach risk primarily through phishing-resistant access controls (MFA, device trust) rather than through awareness-training content.
strengths: Multi-factor authentication supporting over 1.3 billion monthly authentications
Device trust to restrict access to trusted devices

faq.question: Does KnowBe4's published pricing reflect what most customers actually pay?
faq.answer: The per-seat numbers on KnowBe4's pricing page (for example $2.40/user/month for SAT Foundation at 25-50 users) require committing to a 3-year term, and the page itself states "Pricing as per May 2026. List pricing may be modified at any time." Organizations with 1,001+ users must contact KnowBe4 directly for a quote.
